classes.name: Expr
classes.summary: This package describes the data structure of any expression, relation or function used in mathematics. It also describes the assignment of variables. {@link Standard | `Standard`} mathematical functions are implemented such as trigonometrics, hyperbolics, and log functions.

instanceMethods.name: ShallowSimplified
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a GeneralExpression after a simplification of the arguments of <me>.

instanceMethods.name: Copy
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a copy of <me> having the same unknowns and functions.

instanceMethods.name: IsIdentical
instanceMethods.comment: Tests if <me> and <Other> define the same expression. This method does not include any simplification before testing.

instanceMethods.name: IsLinear
instanceMethods.comment: Tests if <me> is linear on every NamedUnknown it contains.

instanceMethods.name: Derivative
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the derivative on <X> unknown of <me>.

instanceMethods.name: Evaluate
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the value of <me> (as a Real) by replacement of <vars> by <vals>. Raises NotEvaluable if <me> contains NamedUnknown not in <vars> or NumericError if result cannot be computed.

instanceMethods.name: String
instanceMethods.comment: returns a string representing <me> in a readable way.

classes.name: Expr_NamedExpression
classes.summary: Describe an expression used by its name (as constants or variables). A single reference is made to a NamedExpression in every Expression (i.e. a NamedExpression is shared).

instanceMethods.name: IsShareable
instanceMethods.comment: Tests if <me> can be shared by one or more expressions or must be copied. This method redefines to a True value the GeneralExpression method.

instanceMethods.name: IsIdentical
instanceMethods.comment: Tests if <me> and <Other> define the same expression. This method does not include any simplification before testing.

instanceMethods.name: String
instanceMethods.comment: returns a string representing <me> in a readable way.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a function of given variables <vars> with name <name> defined by the expression <exp>.

instanceMethods.name: SetName
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the name <newname> to <me>.

instanceMethods.name: GetName
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the name assigned to <me>.

instanceMethods.name: NbOfVariables
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the number of variables of <me>.

instanceMethods.name: Variable
